title: Introduction to File Handling
overview: File handling allows Python programs to create, read, write, and manage files stored on a computer. It is useful for storing data permanently.

title: Opening and Closing Files
overview: Python uses the open() function to access files and the close() method to release file resources after completing operations.

title: Reading Files
overview: Python provides different methods to read file content such as read(), readline(), and readlines().

title: Writing Files
overview: Python allows writing new data into files using write() and append modes.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how Python handles files including opening, reading, writing, and managing file resources.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ open() accesses files.
✔ read() gets file data.
✔ write() stores data.
✔ close() releases resources.
